candidates.name: doc_inspection_priority
candidates.hypothesis: In many failed episodes, search results return relevant documents with high BM25 scores, but the agent fails to inspect them with get_document because the snippet preview cuts off before the relevant fact. Instructing the agent to systematically call get_document on high-relevance search candidates before trying new query variations will uncover obscured clues, increasing validation pass rate from 46.7% to >=53.3% while reducing redundant searches.
candidates.changes: Refine extra_system in context_mgmt to instruct the agent: whenever search returns highly relevant or promising titles/snippets, prioritize inspecting the full document text via get_document immediately rather than continuing to guess alternate search queries.
candidates.expected_efficiency: Slight reduction in total search calls and turns for tasks where relevant documents appear early in search results.
